name: Dr. Seinde Oladapo Fadeni
heroSubtitle: Chairman & Founder with more than 30 years of corporate leadership — shaping high-impact enterprise across Nigeria's Aviation, Energy and Maritime sectors.
executiveProfile: Dr. Seinde Oladapo Fadeni is a Nigerian entrepreneur, investor and corporate leader with more than three decades of experience building, scaling and providing strategic leadership across energy, aviation and maritime sectors. He founded GMT Energy Resources in 2007 and grew it into a $700 million provider of engineering and marine logistics services to Nigeria's oil & gas sector.

Over the course of his career, he has founded and led businesses, chaired corporate boards, and advised on strategic growth, investment and enterprise transformation. His leadership spans both privately held enterprises and major corporate institutions, including NAHCO PLC, GMT Energy Resources and Forte Upstream Services.

As Chairman of NAHCO PLC, he secured multi-year contract renewals with major airlines and led operational transformation that improved turnaround times. At Godsmart, his board leadership delivered a 44% increase in revenue. At Forte Upstream Services, he repositioned the company from core operations into a diversified investment and project-development firm. His board experience also extends internationally: he served on the board of Samsung Heavy Industries Nigeria during the integration of six topside modules for the EGINA FPSO, one of Nigeria's largest offshore energy developments.

He is now focused on building enduring enterprises and identifying strategic investment opportunities capable of competing at scale — within Nigeria, across Africa, and in partnership with international markets.

strategicValueDrivers.title: Capital & M&A Judgment
strategicValueDrivers.desc: Provided strategic M&A advisory as a board member of Consolidated Hallmark Holdings Plc (Dec 2024 – Dec 2025), including identifying and evaluating acquisition opportunities at board level.

strategicValueDrivers.title: Cross-Sector, International Fluency
strategicValueDrivers.desc: Board-level experience spanning aviation, energy and maritime sectors, including service on the board of Samsung Heavy Industries Nigeria during the integration of six topside modules for the EGINA FPSO — one of Nigeria's largest offshore energy developments.
